pictures.name: QAD1-Medina-Lanes
pictures.prompt: Old Medina long ago in the late afternoon: empty sandy lanes between mud-brick houses with palm-trunk beams, date palms, the sun sinking low and casting long uncertain shadows, the simple palm-roofed mosque at the end of the lane. A quiet waiting feeling. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
